name: SLURP: Spoken Language Understanding Resource Package
description: SLURP (Spoken Language Understanding Resource Package) is a multi-modal dataset for task-oriented spoken language understanding (SLU). It contains 72,396 audio recordings (57.5 hours of speech from 177 speakers) mapped to 16,521 text sentences across 18 home-assistant domains (e.g. email, calendar, music, alarm). Utterances are annotated with 69 scenarios, 91 actions, and 56 entity types, enabling end-to-end and pipeline SLU benchmarking.
